minor_findings.detail: The space before ';' in 'en attente ; réexamen' looks like a plain U+0020 in the supplied text. French typography calls for a narrow no-break space (U+202F) or a no-break space (U+00A0) so the semicolon can't wrap onto its own line. I can't confirm the actual code point without seeing the bytes, so please check it in the file.

'réexamen prévu le {next}' only reads correctly if the formatted date has no leading article or preposition, e.g. '12 mars 2026' or '12/03/2026'. That holds for the usual Intl date styles, so this isn't blocking. Check that the date format used for this key fits after 'le'.
'revisión prevista para {next}' is fine with numeric dates. With long-form dates, 'para el {next}' would read more naturally ('para el 12 de marzo de 2026'). Optional.
Same as es: 'prevista para {next}' works. With long-form dates, 'prevista para o dia {next}' or 'para {next}' are both acceptable. Optional.
'पुरानी जानकारी' ('old information') is understandable. 'पूर्व जानकारी' or 'ऐतिहासिक जानकारी' would be slightly closer to the source's 'Historical information' and a bit more formal. Optional.
'Los datos anteriores' narrows 'information' to 'data'. 'La información anterior' would be closer to the source, but the meaning holds. Optional.

checks_performed.placeholder: All six strings contain {next} exactly once, with the original ASCII braces and lowercase name. Nothing is translated, escaped, duplicated or missing.
checks_performed.pending_vs_operation: All six describe verification as not yet done or pending, not as something running now: es/pt-BR 'pendiente/pendente', fr 'en attente', ar 'لم يكتمل بعد' (not yet complete), zh '尚未完成' (not yet complete), hi 'लंबित' (pending). Arabic now keeps verification (التحقق) and review (المراجعة) as separate words, which fixes the first-pass issue.
checks_performed.review_due_semantics: All six present {next} as the scheduled or due review date: es/pt-BR 'prevista para', fr 'prévu le', ar 'موعد المراجعة' (review date), zh '复核日期为' (review date is), hi 'पुनः समीक्षा की तिथि … है' (review date is).
checks_performed.history_not_reverified: All six say the earlier information has not been checked again, and none implies it is wrong or was deleted: es 'no se han verificado nuevamente', fr 'n’ont pas été vérifiées à nouveau', pt-BR 'não foram verificadas novamente', ar 'لم يُعَد التحقق' (correct jussive passive of أعاد: 'was not re-verified'), zh '尚未重新核实' (not yet re-verified), hi 'दोबारा सत्यापन नहीं हुआ है' (has not been verified again).
checks_performed.grammar: No grammar errors found. Gender and number agree in es, fr and pt-BR (verificación/vérification/verificação feminine, plural participles correct). fr uses the typographic apostrophe U+2019 in 'n’ont'.
checks_performed.rtl_ar: Uses the Arabic semicolon '؛' and the Latin full stop, which is normal in modern UI Arabic. {next} sits mid-sentence after a noun phrase. Because the app wraps the date with bidiIsolateForLocale(date, LOCALE), a Latin-digit or LTR date won't reorder the text around it. The string contains no hard-coded directional control characters.
checks_performed.cjk_punctuation_zh: Uses full-width '；' and '。'. The ASCII spaces around {next} are acceptable for an interpolated date.
checks_performed.hi_punctuation: Uses the danda '।' for full stops and an ASCII ';', both acceptable in Hindi UI text.
